qa_pair.question: How many test runs are stored in the runs directory? Answer with a single integer and nothing else.
What is the suite name common to all stored runs? Answer with the exact suite identifier and nothing else.
In the run started at 2026-05-25T09:00:00Z, how many tests failed? Answer with a single integer.

Comparing the run from 2026-05-25 to the run from 2026-05-26 (older to newer), exactly one test regressed (passed before, failed after). What is its fully qualified test id? Answer with the test id and nothing else.
Comparing the run from 2026-05-26 to the run from 2026-05-27 (older to newer), exactly one test went from failing to passing. What is its fully qualified test id?
Across all three stored runs, one test consistently fails with the same error fingerprint. What is its fully qualified test id?
The run from 2026-05-27 introduces a test that did not exist in any earlier run. What is the fully qualified id of that new test?
What is the error type (e.g., AssertionError) reported for the persistently failing test in the run from 2026-05-27? Answer with the error type only.
What git commit SHA is associated with the run from 2026-05-26? Answer with the commit string only.
Comparing the run from 2026-05-25 to the run from 2026-05-27 (older to newer), how many regressions are reported? Answer with a single integer.
